topic.en: Turning the Table: How China’s Ambition for Industrial Upgrading Reverses State-Business Power Relations
topic.zh: 反转局势：中国的产业升级雄心如何逆转政府与企业的权力关系

abstract.en: The paper argues that China’s push to climb the value chain has reversed the usual pattern of state expropriation. Under a model Hu calls State Venture Capitalism, local governments invest state assets in risky private ventures in Strategic Emerging Industries. Because qualified firms are scarce, officials face a seller’s market and tolerate opportunism, under-delivery, and strategic default. Court cases on government–business investment contracts from 2006 to 2021, and a difference-in-differences design around the 2015 Made in China 2025 shock, show more firm breach against local governments among SEI firms after 2015. Firms recruited from outside the jurisdiction drive much of that shift. The claim is an innovation dilemma: to upgrade, an authoritarian state may have to accept predation by the firms it is trying to recruit. The paper contrasts Access Guanxi, in which firms seek politicians, with Recruitment Guanxi, in which officials seek firms they do not already know.
abstract.zh: 论文认为，中国攀升价值链的努力逆转了常见的国家攫取模式。在作者所称的“国家风险资本”模式中，地方政府把国有资产投入战略性新兴产业里高风险的私人项目。合格企业稀缺，官员面对卖方市场，因而容忍机会主义、交付不足和策略性违约。利用 2006–2021 年政企投资合同的法院案件，并以 2015 年《中国制造 2025》为冲击的双重差分显示：2015 年后，战略性新兴产业企业违约、转而“攫取”地方政府的情形显著增加，其中从辖区外招募的企业是主要来源。这意味着一种创新困境：威权国家若要实现产业升级，反而可能不得不忍受它试图培育的企业的掠夺。论文还将企业寻求政治保护的“接近型关系”与官员主动结识陌生企业的“招募型关系”对照起来。

topic.en: Assimilation as a Courtesy: Manchu Bureaucrats and Imperial Personnel Strategy in Qing China (1726–1820)
topic.zh: 作为礼节的同化：满族官僚与清代人事策略（1726–1820）

abstract.en: How do minority rulers govern a majority? Cheng argues that they cultivate partially assimilated co-ethnic elites: officials who learn the majority culture while staying inside minority institutions. Using Chinese courtesy names among Manchu bannermen as a proxy for cultural fluency, and an original panel of about 34,000 position-years and 5,200 Qing officials from 1726 to 1820, the paper finds that Manchus with courtesy names received more important local posts, accumulated more merit grades, rotated between civil posts and banner posts, and were more often recalled to court. Assimilation here is a technology of rule for a dominant minority, not only a strategy of subordinates.
abstract.zh: 少数族群统治者如何治理多数人口？作者认为，他们会培养“部分同化”的本族精英：这些官员习得多数族群的文化，同时仍留在少数族群的制度之内。论文以满洲旗人采用汉文表字作为文化熟练度的代理，并用 1726–1820 年间约 3.4 万个职位—年和 5200 名清代官员的原始面板数据发现：有表字的满人获得更重要的地方职位、积累更多考绩、在民事岗位与旗务岗位之间轮转，也更常被召回朝廷。这里的同化是统治集团维持统治的技术，而不只是从属群体的策略。
